#include "iostream"
#include "string"
#include "vector"
#include "memory"
#include "algorithm"
#include "functional"
#include "type_traits"
#include "utility"
#include "tuple"
#include "variant"
#include "optional"
#include "any"
#include "thread"
#include "future"
#include "chrono"
#include "concepts"
#include "coroutine"
#include "ranges"
#include "span"
// ============================================================================
// C++20 CONCEPTS SECTION
// ============================================================================
// ============================================================================
// COROUTINES SECTION (C++20)
// ============================================================================
/** @brief Simple coroutine return type */
struct SimpleTask {
    /**
     * @brief Constructor
     * @param h Coroutine handle
     */
    SimpleTask(auto h)
    /** @brief Destructor */
    ~SimpleTask()
    /**
     * @brief Move constructor
     * @param other Other task
     */
    SimpleTask(SimpleTask& other)
    /**
     * @brief Move assignment
     * @param other Other task
     * @return Reference to this
     */
    SimpleTask& operator=(SimpleTask& other)
    /** @brief Deleted copy operations */
    SimpleTask(const SimpleTask )
    SimpleTask& operator=(const SimpleTask )
};
// ============================================================================
// ADVANCED TEMPLATE METAPROGRAMMING
// ============================================================================
/**
 * @brief Advanced SFINAE for method detection
 * @tparam T Type to check
 */
template<typename T>
class HasAdvancedMethods {
    static test_serialize(int )
    static test_serialize()
    static test_deserialize(int )
    static test_deserialize()
    static test_validate(int )
    static test_validate()
    static bool has_serialize;
    static bool has_deserialize;
    static bool has_validate;
    static bool is_serializable;
};
// ============================================================================
// ADVANCED CLASSES WITH C++20 FEATURES
// ============================================================================
/**
 * @brief Advanced processor using concepts and coroutines
 * @tparam T Data type (must satisfy AdvancedNumeric concept)
 */
template<typename AdvancedNumeric>
class AdvancedProcessor {
    /**
     * @brief Constructor
     * @param name Processor name
     */
    AdvancedProcessor(const & name)
    /**
     * @brief Process data using concepts
     * @param data Input data
     * @return Processed result
     */
    T process(const T& data)
    /**
     * @brief Process container of data
     * @tparam Container Container type
     * @param container Input container
     * @return Processed results
     */
    template<typename Container>
    processContainer(const Container& container)
    /**
     * @brief Generate sequence using coroutine
     * @param start Starting value
     * @param count Number of values to generate
     * @return Generator coroutine
     */
    generateSequence(T start, size_t count)
    /**
     * @brief Process data asynchronously
     * @param data Input data
     * @return SimpleTask coroutine
     */
    SimpleTask processAsync(const T& data)
};
/** @brief Sophisticated type-erased container */
class TypeErasedContainer {
    /**
     * @brief Store any type that satisfies the concept
     * @tparam T Type to store
     * @param value Value to store
     */
    template<typename T>
    void store(T& value)
    /**
     * @brief Process all stored values
     * @tparam F Function type
     * @param f Processing function
     */
    void processAll(F& f) const
    /**
     * @brief Get stored value by type
     * @tparam T Type to retrieve
     * @return Optional value
     */
    template<typename T>
    get() const
    /**
     * @brief Get size
     * @return Number of stored items
     */
    size_t size() const
};
/**
 * @brief Consteval function for compile-time string processing
 * @param str Input string
 * @return Processed string length
 */
size_t processString(const char* str);
/**
 * @brief Constexpr function with complex logic
 * @tparam T Numeric type
 * @param value Input value
 * @return Processed result
 */
template<typename AdvancedNumeric>
T complexCalculation(T value) const;
/**
 * @brief Use ranges and views (C++20)
 * @tparam Range Range type
 * @param range Input range
 * @return Transformed results
 */
processRange(Range& range);
/** @brief Demonstration of very complex features */
void demonstrateVeryComplexFeatures();
